Name: Labrynna's Conquest
Description: Switch between several races, alternately leading and fending-off Labrynna's conquest of Hyrule.

mission1.Name: Mission 1: A Threat to the Kingdom (Hyrule)
mission1.Description: We have been getting reports of Labrynnian scout parties in the area. Your orders are to locate one and send them a message, removing them from the area by any means neccessary.

mission2.Name: Mission 2: Building a Stronghold (Hyrule)
mission2.Description: In response to the numerous Labrynnian scout parties that have been in this area, Captain Krin has ordered you to set up a stronghold to defend this part of the border from invaders.

mission3.Name: Mission 3: Mountain Pass (Labrynna)
mission3.Description: Since our souting parties were discovered, General Onox has ordered a direct expansion into Hyrule. He has put you in charge of scouting for and capturing a minor pass through their northern mountains, which will be our main invasive route.

mission4.Name: Mission 4: Capture the Pass (Labrynna)
mission4.Description: Now that we have control of that minor pass, General Onox has decided to take Eagle Pass, the main entrance to Hyrule through the mountains.

mission5.Name: Mission 5: Holding the Breach (Hyrule)
mission5.Description: The Labrynnian army has moved through the northern mountains, and is pushing further into our lands. We need to hold them off, while our allies muster their armies to aid us.

mission6.Name: Mission 6: Battle of Kardiko (Hyrule)
mission6.Description:
Our army is arrayed. Our allies march to our aid. The enemy is at hand. Push forward, destroy the armies of Labrynna, and we will win this!

[color="red"]IMPORTANT NOTE: This map does not perform well on computers with low RAM or CPU, I recommend disabling particles.[/color]

mission7.Name: Mission 7: Covering the Escape (Labrynna)
mission7.Description: The invasion was a major failure. We are the only survivors of the army. We need to fall back to Eagle Pass. Captain Edgar has put you in charge of leading a small group of soldiers to hold a choke point so the rest of the army can escape.

mission8.Name: Mission 8: Cut Off! (Labrynna)
mission8.Description: We have been cut off from the others by a avalanche. We need to find an alternate route, before the monsters that dwell in this region find us.
